row.evidence: JFrog's pricing page lists 'Enterprise Access Control (SSO)', which manages users and groups 'using SAML and SCIM', under Enterprise X (starting at $950/month), and the SCIM docs say JFrog provides Enterprise X and Enterprise+ customers with SCIM 2.0.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM and SAML SSO both start at Enterprise X (SaaS, starting at $950/month flat plus usage); Pro is $150/month list, with a limited-time offer of $50/month at the time of checking. Self-managed: Pro X $27,000/year, Enterprise X $51,000/year; SAML on self-managed starts at Pro X. Pricing is flat plus consumption, not per user, so per-user fields and the multiplier stay null (June's 6.3x multiplier on flat prices is dropped under the v3 rules). SCIM uses a scoped admin token (system:identities:r,w,d, default expiry 1 year), endpoints under /access/api/v1/scim/v2, and is verified with Okta and Azure AD. Users and groups cannot be renamed via SCIM. The Entra gallery app is SSO/JIT only, and JFrog says not to use the template app for Azure AD SCIM. The non-SCIM Access REST API (/access/api/v2/users, /groups, /api/v1/roles) is documented, but its plan gate is not.

auth.token_source: Administration | Authentication | SCIM > Generate Token (or the Create Token REST API with scope system:identities:r,w,d)
auth.token_expiry: 1 year by default; configurable (preset times or custom)

endpoints.notes: ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas and ResourceTypes need Artifactory 7.127.0+.

deprovision.notes: Okta's Deactivate Users maps to JFrog's 'Disable user' (PATCH); a separate DELETE removes the user. Pricing is not per seat.

attributes.notes: Taken from the GET Users response schema and example, and the Groups filter. No full attribute list is published; the Schemas endpoint returns the server's definitions.

roles.how: Groups are pushed over SCIM; permissions are granted to groups in JFrog RBAC. No SCIM role attribute is documented.

limitations.text: Users and groups cannot be renamed via SCIM.
The JFrog Artifactory template (gallery) app should not be used with Azure AD; use a non-gallery app with the generic SCIM endpoint.
Requires JFrog Platform 7.17.0 or later; discovery endpoints need Artifactory 7.127.0+.
The SCIM token covers read, write and delete on users and groups only.

endpoints.purpose: Add or remove user from groups

webhooks_user_events.notes: The webhook 'user' domain has only the locked event (failed-login lockout); there are no create/delete user events.

audit_log_api.notes: The Audit Trail Log of user, group and permission changes is a server log file (access-security-audit.log), not a documented API.

limitations.text: Most Access user and group endpoints require admin privileges; list and get also accept a scoped token with system:identities:r.

okta.notes: OIN 'Artifactory' app is tagged SAML and SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password and Group Push (Secure Identity Integration). A separate 'Artifactory Provisioning Connector by Aquera' (third party) is also listed.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SAML with JIT; for SCIM, JFrog points to a non-gallery app using the generic tenant URL.
